description: This file defines a report for subcontract order summaries in an ERP system, including functions to fetch and process purchase order data, supplied items, and generate report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes subcontracted order data based on report filters.

methods.name: get_subcontracted_orders
methods.description: Retrieves purchase orders that are subcontracted within a date range and optional filters.

methods.name: get_filters
methods.description: Builds filter criteria for purchase order query based on report filters.

methods.name: get_supplied_items
methods.description: Retrieves supplied items related to the orders.

methods.name: prepare_subcontracted_data
methods.description: Prepares detailed data structure combining orders and supplied items.

methods.name: get_subcontracted_data
methods.description: Populates the report data list with combined order and supplied item details.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the subcontract order summary report.
